blocking.what: The blocked-request count can clear while Activity is not visible.
blocking.why: ShieldPage keeps the Network panel mounted. IntersectionObserver tests its position, so the hidden panel can remain intersecting. NetworkTab then marks each new event as seen while another tab is open.

residual: The read-only workspace prevented gate verification: Vite could not write its temporary config file, and both Cargo gates could not open the build lock. TypeScript completed before Vite failed.
task_met: The canvas, shield tree, and Apps features are implemented. The carried-over requirement to clear the blocked count only when Activity is visible is not met.
